basic_profile.bio: A Missouri native with a passion for literature and comedy, ShowMeStateSkeptic has been a fixture on Reddit since 2015. With a background in journalism and a keen interest in politics, they often find themselves diving into the intricacies of state and national governance. When not dissecting the political landscape, they enjoy the absurd humor of Comedy Bang Bang and the intricate narratives of Roberto Bolaño. Based in St. Louis, they work as a freelance writer and editor, typically online during early mornings and late evenings. While happily single, they are deeply connected to their community and enjoy engaging in local cultural events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ShowMeStateSkeptic holds a degree in Journalism from the University of Missouri, which laid the foundation for their analytical and critical thinking skills. They have spent years following political developments, both locally and nationally, which has honed their ability to dissect and discuss complex political issues. Their expertise is further complemented by a self-taught appreciation for comedic writing, influenced by their interest in podcasts and satirical literature.
